mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which may lead to increased borrowing and investment, thereby driving up S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases but S&P 500 returns are negative over 20 days more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE) and declining payroll (PAYEMS) signal economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by 0.2pp and PAYEMS decreases
failure_condition: If both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls but S&P 500 returns are positive more than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth exceeds 2% but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO) suggests strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO is above 105 but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If both HOUST and RSAFS meet the trigger but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Low CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) may lead to monetary easing, boosting S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL is below 290 but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: High payroll growth (PAYEMS) indicates strong employment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS exceeds 150000 but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 45% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) together indicate strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If both GDPC1 and HOUST meet the trigger but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 30% of the time.
